newEvidence.finding: T-Carica states that charging can be paid directly by scanning the QR code on the charger, without downloading an app, and also by credit/debit card on integrated POS readers. This is a direct CPO/ad-hoc surface suitable for station/EVSE tariff extraction.

T-Carica separately states that its chargers are accessible through charging apps and RFID providers; those channels must remain separated from the direct QR/POS tariff because they may be roaming/eMSP prices.
Historical PUN inventory lists T-CARICA S.R.L. at 47/47 active charge points. This is inventory corroboration only and not a current tariff source.
